dataset: Historical rainfall - Open-Meteo ERA5/ERA5-Land reanalysis, Mumbai point/grid
source: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (backed by ECMWF ERA5 and ERA5-Land reanalysis)
license: CC-BY 4.0 (Open-Meteo); underlying ERA5 data by ECMWF, Copernicus Climate Change Service, free and open for any use with attribution
download_date: NOT DOWNLOADED (this session's web_fetch tool cannot call parameterized/constructed API URLs - it can only re-fetch URLs that already appear verbatim in search results or the conversation; see scripts/download_rainfall.py which calls this exact endpoint)
crs: N/A (point time series; ERA5-Land native grid is ~9km, ERA5 is ~25-31km)
spatial_resolution: ~9km (ERA5-Land) or ~25km (ERA5) grid cell containing the query point - NOT truly station-level
temporal_resolution: hourly (aggregable to daily/15-min is not physically meaningful beyond hourly)
coverage: 2015-01-01 to present (exceeds the requested 2015-2025 range; full archive back to 1940 available)
file_size: ~1-2 MB per decade of hourly data for one point
quality: medium - reanalysis, not ground-truth gauge data; smooths out convective extremes like the 2005 cloudburst
limitations: No API key required (keyless/free), but IS reanalysis-modeled, not observed rainfall. For ground-truth station data see 07_rainfall/gauges/metadata.json.
notes: Query multiple points across Mumbai's 24 wards (or a coarse grid) for spatial variation, since ERA5-Land's ~9km cells are coarser than the city. Script provided pulls a small multi-point sample.
